components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single emphasized action in a Hero or decision point.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; color: #fff; background: #075ff7; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(7,95,247,.22); font: 650 16px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0752d6; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet companion action beside the primary button.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; color: #10233f; background: #edf3fc; font: 650 16px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f1f5fc; color: #075ff7; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Documentation Navigation
components.description: Compact access to the guide, API, React integration, and package registry.
components.html: GuidePatch APIReactnpm ↗
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; font: 650 14px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #10233f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #075ff7; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Runtime Trace Node
components.description: One stage on the continuous Original → Patches → Runtime path.
components.css: .ds-trace-node { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #10233f; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-trace-node span { display: grid; width: 26px; height: 26px; place-items: center; border: 5px solid #f9fbff; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: #075ff7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(7,95,247,.2); font: 460 12px/1 'Source Code Pro', monospace; } .ds-trace-node small { color: #40536d; } .ds-trace-node code { margin-top: 6px; color: #075ff7; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: A distinct executable layer within long-form documentation.
components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; padding: 20px 24px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid rgba(127,172,233,.18); border-radius: 14px; color: #eef5ff; background: #0b1f3a; box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(13,36,71,.12); font: 460 14px/1.55 'Source Code Pro', monospace; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A precise service manual on translucent technical sheets. Original plugin state stays conceptually visible while each Patch adds a controlled layer; cobalt paths and highly legible type keep the system calm, native, and inspectable.

rules.name: The Signal Path Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks actionable or structural points; cyan appears only as movement between them.

rules.name: The Whole-Word Rule
rules.body: Technical nouns and transformation terms wrap between words, never inside them.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat unless they represent a distinct interactive or rendered layer.

dos: Use uninterrupted paths for ordered transformations.
Keep English and Simplified Chinese navigation equivalent.
Respect reduced motion and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not turn every concept into a rounded card.
Do not use cyan as a general action color.
Do not crop or flatten the Harmony mark.
Do not introduce dashboard or game-mod styling.
